name: relevo
description: Relay between local sessions: one plans, named workers (builder, researcher, reviewer...) build, research or review, and they hand work back and forth on their own. In herdr the planner starts its workers itself.

maxRounds.title: Max rounds
maxRounds.description: Rounds the planner may send before relevo pauses itself.

maxWorkers.title: Max workers
maxWorkers.description: Workers a planner may link or start in herdr.
